decision_conditions: <p>No sewage or trade effluent, including cooling water containing chemical additives, or vehicle washing water, including steam cleaning effluent, shall be discharged to the surface water drainage system.&nbsp;</p>

<p>The work shall be carried out in accordance with the conclusions and recommendations in the submitted Arboricultural Report_Ref: 21919/AJB and in accordance with the British Standard 3998 Recommendations for Tree Work ( including any subsequent revisions).&nbsp;</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall not be commenced until details of the following have been</p><p>submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority:</p><p>i. works for the disposal of sewage</p><p>ii. works for the disposal of surface water</p><p>iii. surface water attenuation and storage works</p><p>iv. basement flood protection details including waterproofing and water tanking details,</p><p>v. full details of permeable paving should be submitted, including a cross-section of the permeable paving construction.</p><p>The details will be required to demonstrate that there will be no harm to the lake on site in terms of pollution. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.&nbsp;</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: Planning Statement (Rural Solutions); Design and access statement (July 2020); Conservation Engineering Assessment (Conisbee - Dated: 06/05/20216); Heritage Assessment; Drainage Statement: 14074/CR/01 (Paul Waite - Dated: August 2017); Heritage Statement; Ecological Appraisal Survey (Arbtech); Structural and Geotechnical Conservation Assessment (Conisbee - Dated: 14/11/2016); Arboricultural Report_Ref: 21919/AJB; 14.162 01; 14.162 012 D; 14.162 03; 14.162 04 B; 14.162 05 B; 14.162 09 D; 14.162 11 B; 14.162 12 C.&nbsp;</p><p>- and plans and documents received for this application -14.162 02 E, 14.162 09 D (proposed plans), 14.162 10D, 14.162 11C (proposed new dwelling), 14.162 13E, Planning Statement (Rural Solutions), Design and Access Statement (Dec 2024).</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall not commence until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces noted below have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority: (a) the extension/building(s) (b) the ground surfacing (c) the boundary treatment The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.&nbsp;</p><div><br></div>

<p>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no windows/doors, other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevations of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.&nbsp;</p>

<p>No development shall take place, including any works of demolition, until a Construction Method Statement has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The Method</p><p>Statement shall provide for:</p><p>a) detailed timeline for the phases and implementation of the development</p><p>b) demolition method statement</p><p>c) the parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors;</p><p>d) loading and unloading of plant and materials;</p><p>e) storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development;</p><p>f) measures to control the emission of dust and dirt during construction; and</p><p>g) scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works. </p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Method Statement &amp; Logistics Plan, or any amendment or variation to it as may be agreed in writing by the local planning authority throughout the construction period. This is a PRE-COMMENCEMENT Condition.&nbsp;</p><div><br></div>

<p>No demolition or site works in connection with the development hereby permitted shall commence before:- (a) the frontage. (b) the boundary. of the site is enclosed by a close boarded fence to a minimum height of 2 metres. Such fencing shall remain until works and clearance have been completed, and the development is ready for occupation.&nbsp;</p>

<p>No site works or development shall commence until details of the levels of the building(s), road(s) and footpath(s) in relation to the adjoining land and highway(s), and any other changes proposed in the levels of the site, have been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority.&nbsp;</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until there has been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority in writing, a scheme of hard and soft landscape works for the site. Soft landscape works shall include planting plans, and schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers / densities, written specification of planting and cultivations to be undertaken.&nbsp;</p>

<p>All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons before the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner. Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Before the hard surfacing hereby permitted is brought into use the surfacing shall EITHER be constructed from porous materials, for example, gravel, permeable block paving or porous asphalt, OR provision shall be made to direct run-off water from the hard surfacing to a permeable or porous area or surface within the curtilage of the site.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order with or without modification), no development which would otherwise fall within Classes A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H in Part 1 of Schedule 2 to that Order shall be carried out in relation to the dwellinghouse hereby permitted without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.&nbsp;</p>

<p>-Notwithstanding the approved plans, the building hereby permitted shall not be constructed above damp proof course level until details of bird and boxes to be sited within suitable locations have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved details shall be implemented before occupation of the development and shall thereafter be retained.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved, a Fire Safety Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this statement shall include details of how the development will function in terms of the following: </p><p>1) identify suitably positioned unobstructed outside space: a) for fire appliances to be positioned on b) appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point </p><p>2) is designed to incorporate appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and passive and active fire safety measures </p><p>3) is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread </p><p>4) provide suitable and convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building users </p><p>5) develop a robust management strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published (details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in </p><p>6) provide suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the development. The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.&nbsp;</p><div><br></div>
<p>The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of the original permission, planning permission ref:&nbsp;P/2188/23&nbsp; dated 13-06-2024.</p>
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) attached to planning permission P/2188/23 dated 13/06/2024 to allow amendment to the change of the size of the approved basement
